verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Shopify's sales channels, marketplace integrations (Amazon, eBay), social commerce (Facebook/Instagram/TikTok shops), or shopping feed sync features — only generic app/API extensibility, headless storefronts, markets (currency/region), and POS. Multi-channel catalog sync to external marketplaces/social platforms is a distinct, well-known Shopify capability but is simply absent from this evidence pack, so it cannot be credited here.
